Lead Product Manager - Digital Banking
Kotak Mahindra Bank
Mumbai, Maharashtra, India (On-site)

About Kotak Digital:
We are reimagining mobile banking for over 30 million digital consumers in India.

Responsibilities:
• Lead a portfolio of financial products, overseeing roadmap, P&L, and compliance requirements.
• Define enterprise product vision, user journey architecture, and vendor management.
• Manage a team of product managers and drive Agile execution with 40+ engineers.

Requirements:
• Minimum 6+ years of product management experience, preferably in banking or fintech.
• Education: Strictly Tier-1 engineering (IIT/BITS/NIT) and premier MBA (IIM/XLRI/ISB) only.
• Master of Business Administration (MBA is mandatory).
• Proven leadership driving revenue and large-scale cross-functional programs.
